# Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Notes and artifacts assembled around a single subject, where each member is a part of the whole rather than one more instance of a kind.

## Scope note

Parent context for all notes associated with a single subject, like DayCluster, WeekCluster, MonthCluster, EffortCluster, TopicCluster, ConceptCluster, OutputCluster, etc.

## Broader

- [Knowledge](../Knowledge/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
